shared_elements: vertical field of abstract relief signs
justification: The most specific correspondence is the use of schematic curvilinear relief signs including circular eye/disc-like forms and possible face-like elements on a vertical surface. The biggest difference is that A is organized as a large frontal anthropomorphic body with head, torso, and paired chest circles, whereas B is a dense stacked panel of glyphic/zoomorphic motifs without the same body scheme or element relationships.
